sources.gs_filter_note: Starters are filtered to GS>0 on the season pitching line. When that line is unavailable the filter is SKIPPED (gs_filter_applied=false) and every folded starter is served with gs=null, rather than an empty GS map dropping the whole board.

note: Realized in-game leverage impact, self-computed from the MLB StatsAPI winProbability feed (FanGraphs is blocked for autonomous pulls). Batters: WPA, average Leverage Index faced (pLI), and Clutch (WPA/pLI minus WPA/LI). Starters: per-start WPA and WPA/LI. Descriptive realized value, not a predictive model.
